name: Runner Low
alt: Runner Low in off-white leather, a pair seen from above on grey concrete, laced over a flat rubber sole
material: Full-grain leather upper, rubber cup sole
description: Off-white leather on a thick rubber cup sole. It wipes clean, which is most of why we stock it in this colour. The sole is stiff for the first few wears.
care: Wipe with a damp cloth. Keep it out of the washing machine.

name: Court Canvas
alt: Court Canvas in black cotton canvas with a cream toe cap, a pair on a white sheet, on a vulcanised sole
description: Heavy black canvas with a cream toe cap, on a vulcanised rubber sole. Light, and it packs flat. Canvas soaks through in rain and takes a day to dry.
care: Hand wash cold with a brush. Air dry out of direct sun.

name: Trail Mid
alt: Trail Mid in tobacco leather, a pair from above on a wooden floor, laced high over the instep on a dark lugged sole
fitNote: Cut wide — size down if you are between
description: Water-repellent leather on a lugged sole that grips wet stone. Cut high enough to hold the ankle. It is a heavy shoe and you notice that by the end of a long day.
care: Let mud dry, then brush it off. Re-proof the leather every few months.

name: Canvas Slip
alt: Canvas Slip in charcoal cotton canvas, a pair side-on in sand, no laces, on a jute-wrapped sole
material: Cotton canvas, elastic gore, jute-wrapped sole
description: Charcoal canvas with elastic at the sides, so it goes on without hands. Jute-wrapped sole. There is no lace to tighten, so a narrow foot can slip at the heel.

name: Oxford Cap-Toe
alt: Oxford Cap-Toe in black calf leather, a pair from above on a dark wooden floor, closed lacing and a stitched sole
material: Calf leather, leather sole, Goodyear welt
fitNote: Runs true to size, narrow at the waist
description: Black calf leather on a stitched leather sole, made for indoors and dry days. The welt means a cobbler can resole it. Leather soles are slippery on wet tile and wear down fast on rough pavement.
care: Cream and brush every few weeks. Use shoe trees between wears.

name: Derby Plain
alt: Derby Plain in tan waxed leather, a pair from above on a cream floor in low sun, open lacing over a stacked heel
description: Waxed tan calf leather with open lacing, so it opens wide for a high instep. Plain toe, nothing on it. The wax picks up scuffs and you will see them.
care: Wipe after wear. Polish when the shine dulls.

name: Brogue Wing
alt: Brogue Wing in chestnut leather, a pair from above on tan suede, wingtip seam and punched detail over a stacked heel
material: Hand-burnished calf leather, stacked leather heel
description: Chestnut leather burnished by hand, so no two pairs come out the same. The punching goes through the leather rather than being printed on it. It is a loud shoe and it will not disappear under a suit.
care: Polish with a neutral cream. Water spots the burnishing, so dry it off quickly.

name: Penny Loafer
alt: Penny Loafer in tan suede, a pair from above on a white painted floor, saddle strap across the vamp on a flat sole
material: Suede upper, leather lining, flat sole
fitNote: Slips half a size roomy — size down if between
description: Tan suede with a leather lining and a flat sole. It goes on and off without hands. Suede marks in the rain, and tan shows those marks more than a dark colour would.
care: Brush it after wear. Keep a suede eraser around for scuffs.

name: Tassel Loafer
alt: Tassel Loafer in cognac calf leather, a pair from above on navy cloth, low topline over a slim leather sole
material: Calf leather, leather lining, slim sole
description: Cognac calf leather on a slim sole, cut low at the topline. Dressier than the penny loafer. That low cut can rub the ankle bone until the leather softens.
care: Cream and brush. Shoe trees keep the vamp from creasing.

name: Driver Moc
alt: Driver Moc in tan suede, a pair on white marble, soft unlined upper on a pebbled rubber sole
fitNote: Stretches with wear — take your usual size
description: Unlined tan suede with rubber pebbles in place of a sole. Soft from the first wear because there is no lining to break in. That thin sole is meant for the car and the house, not a day on concrete.
care: Brush the suede. Do not soak it.

name: Kolhapuri Slide
alt: Kolhapuri Slide in natural tan leather, a pair on rippled sand, straps over a flat stitched footbed
description: Vegetable-tanned buffalo hide, stitched by hand in Kolhapur. The leather darkens as you wear it. It is stiff for the first week and the toe strap can rub until it gives.
care: Keep it dry. Work in a little leather oil if it stiffens up.

name: Strap Sandal
alt: Strap Sandal in black leather with a tan band across the toes, a pair on white slats, on a moulded footbed
description: Black milled leather with a tan band across the toes, on a moulded EVA footbed. Light for how solid it looks. The footbed takes a few days to shape to your foot.
care: Wipe the footbed with a damp cloth. Air it out after hot days.
